subject: Bookings → Billing orchestration: PO timing & invoice dependencies
messages:
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, procurement@bluefin.com
Cc: acme-corp-pm@acme.com
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Bookings → Billing orchestration: PO timing & invoice dependencies

Hi team / BlueFin,

Quick note to align on the PO → invoice handoff so we can recognize the May bookings in June close. High level: BlueFin’s PO arrival and the invoice cutoff windows across finance systems determine when we can record revenue. To avoid surprises in the June forecast we need a short checklist completed this week.

Key ask (actionable):
- BlueFin: confirm PO upload date and if billing should use the PO number or SOW reference on invoices (we can support either).
- Finance (Laura): confirm the invoice processing cutoff for the June allocation (we currently have a hard cutoff of 11:59pm PST on 2027-05-31, confirm if that holds).
- Ops (Marcus): advise if any manual GL mapping will be needed for this account — we saw a mismatch last quarter and want to avoid reclassification.

Attachment: po_timing_matrix.xlsx (matrix with proposed invoice dates, routing, and dependencies).

Proposed small cadence: 15-min sync on Mon 2027-05-03 (09:00 PT) to lock timings. If the PO slips beyond 2027-05-04 we should evaluate booking deferral.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

--
Redwood Inference — inference for production-grade LLMs

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@bluefin.com
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bookings → Billing orchestration: PO timing & invoice dependencies

Jonas — thanks for pulling this together. Quick answers and notes: 

1) Invoice cutoff: our AR team needs invoices submitted to the billing queue by 11:59pm PST on 2027-05-31 to be included in the June recognition batch. If the vendor (BlueFin) requires Net30 on their side we still need the invoice in the queue before cutoff to honor the booking.

2) PO fields: we prefer explicit PO number in the invoice header (PO# field) but will accept SOW ref as long as PO is present in the body. Please ask BlueFin to include both if possible — reduces manual exceptions.

3) GL mapping: Marcus — please confirm whether BlueFin should map to revenue code 4002 or if we need to create a one-off mapping. Last quarter we had to push one through via a journal entry which delayed recognition.

I can join the Mon 09:00 PT sync — if BlueFin can commit to providing the PO by EOD Mon 2027-05-03 we’re in a good spot. If it slips to Tue 2027-05-04 we should plan to defer recognition and update the forecast.

Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Attachment: mutual-action-plan-v2.pdf (redlines included)

From: procurement@bluefin.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: acme-corp-pm@acme.com, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bookings → Billing orchestration: PO timing & invoice dependencies

Hi Jonas / Laura / Marcus,

Thanks for the clear matrix. We will submit PO# BF-77821 to you by EOD Monday 2027-05-03. Confirming: the PO will include the SOW reference (Redwood SOW #RWD-832) and the PO number in the header. We expect no further procurement approvals.

We would like Redwood to invoice on 2027-05-04 (preferred) so internal approvals align on our end (we run our AP cycle on Tuesdays). If invoicing on 2027-05-04 is not possible given your cutoff, please advise next-best invoice date and we will accept.

Attachments: BlueFin_PO_BF-77821.pdf (stamped, placeholder until formal upload).

Thanks —
Maya Patel
Procurement Manager | BlueFin Health
procurement@bluefin.com

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, procurement@bluefin.com
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bookings → Billing orchestration: PO timing & invoice dependencies

Thanks Maya — that works. Quick internal notes (locking items for the forecast):

> From: procurement@bluefin.com
> Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 08:22:00 -0700
> Subject: Re: Bookings → Billing orchestration: PO timing & invoice dependencies
>
> Thanks for the clear matrix. We will submit PO# BF-77821 to you by EOD Monday 2027-05-03.

Internal action items / confirmations:
- I will request the one-off GL mapping to revenue code 4002 today and flag AR to expect invoice with PO BF-77821.
- If BlueFin sends the invoice dated 2027-05-04 we can post it in our system immediately and still meet recognition for the June batch provided the invoice is in the queue before 05-31 cutoff. Laura — please confirm we don't need extra approvals on our side for posting an invoice dated 2027-05-04.
- Jonas — I'll own the AR escalation path if anything hits an exception; ping me on slack if you see a delay.

I’ll join the 09:00 PT sync tomorrow morning for the final go/no-go.

Marcus Lin
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
